<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:center;margin:0pt;"><b>AMES NATIONAL CORPORATION </b></p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:center;margin:0pt;"><b>ANNOUNCES EARNINGS FOR THE FOURTH QUARTER OF <a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725380975514">2025</a> </b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">Ames, Iowa &#8211; Ames National Corporation (Nasdaq: ATLO; the &#8220;Company&#8221;) today reported net income for the fourth quarter of <a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725380975514">2025</a> of <a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736524932623">$6.5</a>&nbsp;million, or <a data-tblloc="3x1" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736524943113">$0.73</a>&nbsp;per share, compared to <a data-tblloc="2x2" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736524949296">$3.5</a>&nbsp;million, or <a data-tblloc="3x2" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736524955144">$0.39</a>&nbsp;per share, earned in the fourth quarter of <a data-tblloc="3x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381105398">2024</a>. For the year ended <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381205963">December 31, 2025</a>, net income for the Company totaled <a data-tblloc="2x6" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736524970768">$19.0</a>&nbsp;million or <a data-tblloc="3x6" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736524977636">$2.14</a>&nbsp;per share, compared to <a data-tblloc="2x7" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736524984360">$10.2</a>&nbsp;million or <a data-tblloc="3x7" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736524990022">$1.14</a>&nbsp;per share earned in <a data-tblloc="3x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381105398">2024</a>. The increase in earnings&nbsp;is primarily due to an increase in net interest income. Net interest income increased due to higher yields on loans and investments, combined with a lower cost of funds driven by declining market rates and reduced borrowings.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><b>Fourth Quarter <a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725380975514">2025</a> Results:</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">Fourth quarter <a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725380975514">2025</a> loan interest income was <a data-tblloc="4x3" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736525478736">$600</a>&nbsp;thousand higher than fourth quarter <a data-tblloc="3x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381105398">2024</a> and was primarily due to improved yield on the loan portfolio.&nbsp;Interest income from investment securities increased by $688&nbsp;thousand during this same period due to maturities reinvested at higher rates. Deposit interest expense decreased&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x3" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736525508529">$1.1</a>&nbsp;million during this same period due primarily to decreases&nbsp;in market rates. Other borrowed funds interest expense decreased&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="11x3" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736525536521">$650</a>&nbsp;thousand during the same period due primarily to reduced borrowings. Nonaccrual interest income of $140 thousand was recognized in the fourth quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="577152" data-tblv="9" id="led577152F20260161768582011971">2025</a>. Fourth quarter <a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725380975514">2025</a> net interest income totaled <a data-tblloc="6x1" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736525692167">$15.2</a>&nbsp;million, an&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="6x5" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736525700851">increase</a> of <a data-tblloc="6x3" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736525708473">$3.1</a>&nbsp;million, or <a data-tblloc="6x4" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736525714626">25.7%</a>, compared to the same quarter a year ago. These factors were the primary contributors to the Company&#8217;s net interest margin, on a tax-equivalent basis (a non-GAAP measure), improving&nbsp;to&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="14x1" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736525736341">3.00%</a>&nbsp;for the quarter ended <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381205963">December 31, 2025</a> as compared to <a data-tblloc="14x2" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736525744164">2.38%</a>&nbsp;for the quarter ended <a data-tblloc="6x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381255054">December 31, 2024</a>&nbsp; and 2.83% for the quarter ended September 30, 2025.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">A credit loss benefit&nbsp;of (<a data-tblloc="7x1" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736525922482">$660</a>) thousand was recognized in the fourth quarter of <a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725380975514">2025</a> as compared to a credit loss benefit&nbsp;of (<a data-tblloc="7x2" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736525937943">$130</a>) thousand in the fourth quarter of <a data-tblloc="3x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381105398">2024</a>. Net loan recoveries totaled <a data-tblloc="15x1" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736526760563">$455</a>&nbsp;thousand for the quarter ended <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381205963">December 31, 2025</a> compared to net loan charge-offs of <a data-tblloc="15x2" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736526768476">$447</a>&nbsp;thousand for the quarter ended <a data-tblloc="6x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381255054">December 31, 2024</a>. The credit loss benefit in <a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725380975514">2025</a> was primarily due to net recoveries in the commercial operating loan portfolio.&nbsp;The credit loss benefit in <a data-tblloc="3x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381105398">2024</a> was primarily due to a reduction in specific reserves and less outstanding off balance sheet credit exposures.</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">Noninterest income for the fourth quarter of <a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725380975514">2025</a> totaled <a data-tblloc="8x1" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736526866248">$3.4</a>&nbsp;million as compared to <a data-tblloc="8x2" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736526874240">$2.6</a>&nbsp;million in the fourth quarter of <a data-tblloc="3x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381105398">2024</a>, an <a data-tblloc="8x5" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736526882330">increase</a>&nbsp;of <a data-tblloc="8x4" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736526893236">31.2%</a>. The&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="8x5" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736526905886">increase</a> is primarily due to an increase in wealth management income and gain on sale of other real estate owned.&nbsp; The increase in wealth management income is primarily&nbsp;due to growth in assets under management and an increase in estate and trust fees. The gain on sale of other real estate resulted from a $2.6 million nonperforming commercial real estate loan that was foreclosed upon and subsequently sold during the quarter.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">Noninterest expense for the fourth quarter of <a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725380975514">2025</a> totaled <a data-tblloc="9x1" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736526966225">$11.1</a>&nbsp;million compared to <a data-tblloc="9x2" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736526971859">$10.5</a>&nbsp;million recorded in the fourth quarter of <a data-tblloc="3x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381105398">2024</a>, an&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="9x5" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736526986274">increase</a> of <a data-tblloc="9x4" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736526978565">4.9%</a>. The&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="9x5" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736526991233">increase</a> reflects higher salaries and benefits, driven by anticipated bonus payouts and an additional one day of paid time off provided to all employees in celebration of the Company's 50th anniversary.&nbsp;The efficiency ratio was <a data-tblloc="8x2" data-tblname="600928" data-tblv="9" id="led600928F20250101736527019430">59.22%</a>&nbsp;for the fourth quarter of <a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725380975514">2025</a> as compared to <a data-tblloc="8x4" data-tblname="600928" data-tblv="9" id="led600928F20250101736527027435">71.47%</a>&nbsp;in the fourth quarter of <a data-tblloc="3x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381105398">2024</a>. The improved efficiency ratio was primarily due to an increase in net interest income and noninterest income.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">Income tax expense for the fourth quarter of <a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725380975514">2025</a> totaled <a data-tblloc="10x1" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736527065611">$1.8</a>&nbsp;million compared to <a data-tblloc="10x2" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736527072154">$825</a>&nbsp;thousand recorded in the fourth quarter of <a data-tblloc="3x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381105398">2024</a>. The effective tax rate was <a data-tblloc="12x1" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736527086807">21%</a>&nbsp;and <a data-tblloc="12x2" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736527092008">19%</a>&nbsp;for the quarters ended <a data-tblloc="7x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381180056">December 31, 2025 and 2024</a>, respectively. The lower than expected tax rate in&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F20260141768420733370">2025</a> and&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="3x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F20260141768420742102">2024</a> was primarily due to tax-exempt interest income and New Markets Tax Credits.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><b>Year <a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725380975514">2025</a> Results:</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">For the year ended <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381205963">December 31, 2025</a> loan interest income was <a data-tblloc="4x8" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736535068378">$2.6</a>&nbsp;million higher than the year ended <a data-tblloc="6x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381255054">December 31, 2024</a>. The&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="4x10" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736535078784">increase</a> is primarily due to improved yield on the loan portfolio. Interest-bearing deposits with banks and federal funds sold interest income increased by $1.3&nbsp;million during this same period due to higher average balances. Deposit interest expense decreased&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x8" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736535100380">$3.1</a>&nbsp;million during the same period due primarily to decreases&nbsp;in market rates. Other borrowed funds interest expense decreased&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="11x8" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736535129437">$3.1</a>&nbsp;million during the same period due primarily to reduced borrowings. The net interest income for the year ended <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381205963">December 31, 2025</a> totaled <a data-tblloc="6x6" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736535153216">$55.7</a>&nbsp;million, an&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="6x10" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736535162260">increase</a>&nbsp;of <a data-tblloc="6x8" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736535171626">$10.7</a>&nbsp;million, or <a data-tblloc="6x9" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736535178225">23.8%</a>, compared to the same period a year ago. These factors were the primary contributors to the&nbsp;Company&#8217;s net interest margin, on a tax-equivalent basis (a non-GAAP measure), improving to&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="9x6" data-tblname="600928" data-tblv="9" id="led600928F20250101736535199173">2.75%</a>&nbsp;for the year ended <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381205963">December 31, 2025</a> as compared to <a data-tblloc="9x8" data-tblname="600928" data-tblv="9" id="led600928F20250101736535206873">2.22%</a>&nbsp;for the year ended <a data-tblloc="6x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381255054">December 31, 2024</a>.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">A credit loss expense of <a data-tblloc="7x6" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736535391171">$1.0</a>&nbsp;million was recognized for the year ended <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381205963">December 31, 2025</a> as compared to a credit loss expense of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="7x7" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736535405873">$592</a> thousand for the year ended <a data-tblloc="6x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381255054">December 31, 2024</a>. Net loan charge-offs totaled <a data-tblloc="15x6" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736535601651">$357</a>&nbsp;thousand for the year ended <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381205963">December 31, 2025</a> compared to net loan charge-offs of <a data-tblloc="15x7" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736535609882">$453</a>&nbsp;thousand for the year ended <a data-tblloc="6x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381255054">December 31, 2024</a>. The credit loss expense in <a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725380975514">2025</a> was primarily due to an increase in specific reserves in the commercial real estate and operating loan portfolios. The credit loss expense in <a data-tblloc="3x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381105398">2024</a> was primarily due to growth in the loan portfolio and charge-offs in the commercial loan portfolio.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">Noninterest income for the year ended <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381205963">December 31, 2025</a> totaled <a data-tblloc="8x6" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736535717431">$11.2</a>&nbsp;million compared to <a data-tblloc="8x7" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736535724649">$9.8</a>&nbsp;million for the year ended <a data-tblloc="6x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381255054">December 31, 2024</a>, an&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="8x10" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736535733176">increase</a> of <a data-tblloc="8x9" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736535738354">13.4%</a>. The&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="8x10" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736535750294">increase</a> is primarily due to an increase in wealth management income due to growth in assets under management and an increase in estate and trust fees.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">Noninterest expense for the year ended <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381205963">December 31, 2025</a> totaled <a data-tblloc="9x6" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736535795850">$41.9</a>&nbsp;million compared to <a data-tblloc="9x7" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736535801697">$42.0</a>&nbsp;million for the year ended <a data-tblloc="6x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381255054">December 31, 2024</a>, a&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="9x10" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736535808853">decrease</a> of <a data-tblloc="9x9" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736535817683">0.1%</a>. The&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="9x10" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736535812358">decrease</a> in noninterest expense is&nbsp;primarily due to&nbsp;$799&nbsp;thousand of consultant fees for certain contract negotiations completed in 2024 and cost savings reflected in 2025. The cost savings were offset by an increase in salaries and benefits primarily&nbsp;due to normal raises and anticipated bonus payouts as Company performance thresholds are met. The efficiency ratio was <a data-tblloc="8x6" data-tblname="600928" data-tblv="9" id="led600928F20250101736535849192">62.74%</a>&nbsp;and <a data-tblloc="8x8" data-tblname="600928" data-tblv="9" id="led600928F20250101736535855400">76.59%</a>&nbsp;for the year ended <a data-tblloc="7x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381180056">December 31, 2025 and 2024</a>, respectively.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">Income tax expense for the year ended <a data-tblloc="7x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381180056">December 31, 2025 and 2024</a> totaled <a data-tblloc="10x6" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736535876910">$4.8</a>&nbsp;million and <a data-tblloc="10x7" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736535883092">$2.0</a>&nbsp;million, respectively. The effective tax rate was <a data-tblloc="12x6" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736535891022">20%</a>&nbsp;and <a data-tblloc="12x7" data-tblname="577187" data-tblv="9" id="led577187F20250101736535897370">17%</a>&nbsp;for the year ended <a data-tblloc="7x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381180056">December 31, 2025 and 2024</a>, respectively. The lower than expected tax rate in&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F20250101736535939120">2025</a> and&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="3x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F20250101736535945218">2024</a> was due primarily to tax-exempt interest income and New Markets Tax Credits.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><b>Balance Sheet Review:</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">As of <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381205963">December 31, 2025</a>, total assets were <a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736536059991">$2.13</a>&nbsp;billion, an&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x5" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736536068526">increase</a> of <a data-tblloc="2x3" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736536076245">$360</a>&nbsp;thousand, as compared to <a data-tblloc="6x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381255054">December 31, 2024</a>. The&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x5" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736536094692">increase</a> in assets is primarily due to&nbsp;an increase in interest-bearing deposits in financial institutions, decrease in unrealized losses on securities available-for-sale and partially offset by a decrease in loans receivable.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">Securities available-for-sale as of <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381205963">December 31, 2025</a> increased&nbsp;to <a data-tblloc="3x1" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736536118280">$656.0</a>&nbsp;million from <a data-tblloc="3x2" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736536124842">$648.5</a>&nbsp;million as of <a data-tblloc="6x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381255054">December 31, 2024</a>. The&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="3x5" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736536131636">increase</a> in securities available-for-sale is primarily due to lower unrealized losses in the investment portfolio.&nbsp;The Company's investment portfolio had an expected duration of 3.0&nbsp;years as of <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381205963">December 31, 2025</a>. There are $94&nbsp;million of investments maturing in&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="20x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F20250101736536427910">2026</a> at an average yield of approximately 1.4%.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">Net loans as of <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381205963">December 31, 2025</a> decreased&nbsp;to <a data-tblloc="4x1" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736536474903">$1.28</a>&nbsp;billion, as compared to <a data-tblloc="4x2" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736536484804">$1.30</a>&nbsp;billion as of <a data-tblloc="6x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381255054">December 31, 2024</a>, a&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="4x5" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736536728609">decrease</a> of <a data-tblloc="4x4" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736536721951">1.8%</a>. The decrease was primarily due to a decline in the commercial real estate loan portfolio and partially offset by an increase in the 1 to 4 family residential and multi-family real estate portfolios. Substandard loans were $42.2&nbsp;million and $35.5&nbsp;million as of <a data-tblloc="7x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F20250101736544843879">December 31, 2025 and 2024</a>, respectively.&nbsp; Substandard-impaired loans were $14.6&nbsp;million and $14.2&nbsp;million as of <a data-tblloc="7x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F20250101736544849865">December 31, 2025 and 2024</a>, respectively. The increase in substandard loans is primarily due to weakening in the multi-family loan portfolio. Some multi-family real estate loans are experiencing a decline in occupancy rates. The increase in&nbsp;substandard-impaired loans is primarily due to&nbsp;one agricultural loan relationship. There are approximately $348&nbsp;million of loans maturing within one year at an average yield&nbsp;of approximately&nbsp;5.5%.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">The allowance for credit losses on <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381205963">December 31, 2025</a> totaled <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736537017392">$17.7</a>&nbsp;million, or <a data-tblloc="6x4" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736540016257">1.36%</a>&nbsp;of loans, compared to <a data-tblloc="5x2" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736537030571">$17.1</a>&nbsp;million, or <a data-tblloc="6x9" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736540003967">1.29%</a>&nbsp;of loans, as of <a data-tblloc="6x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381255054">December 31, 2024</a>. The increase in the allowance for credit losses is primarily due to an increase in specific reserves.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">Deposits totaled <a data-tblloc="7x1" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736544595982">$1.855</a>&nbsp;billion as of <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381205963">December 31, 2025</a>, an&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="7x5" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736544612136">increase</a> of <a data-tblloc="7x4" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736544618328">0.4%</a>, compared to <a data-tblloc="7x2" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736544623714">$1.847</a>&nbsp;billion recorded as of <a data-tblloc="6x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381255054">December 31, 2024</a>. The nominal&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="7x5" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736544653480">increase</a> in deposits is primarily due to increases in&nbsp;commercial demand and interest-bearing checking accounts. Securities sold under agreements to repurchase decreased to&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="12x1" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20260161768582176071">$38.8</a> million as of <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F20260161768582197371">December 31, 2025</a>, compared to&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="12x2" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20260161768582184426">$52.4</a> million as of <a data-tblloc="6x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F20260161768582204301">December 31, 2024</a>. Securities sold under agreements to repurchase and deposit&nbsp;balances fluctuate as customers&#8217; liquidity needs vary and could be impacted by prevailing market interest rates, competition, and economic conditions.&nbsp;Approximately 14% of deposits are tied to external indexes as of <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F20260161768582213323">December 31, 2025</a>. Deposit interest expense related to these deposits can be more volatile than other deposit products in a changing interest rate environment.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">Other borrowings decreased to&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="8x1" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736544785209">$21.4</a>&nbsp;million as of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F20250101736544820756">December 31, 2025</a> compared to&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="8x2" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736544792412">$47.0</a>&nbsp;million as of <a data-tblloc="6x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F20250101736544826302">December 31, 2024</a>.&nbsp; The Company has reduced borrowings throughout&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F20250101736544832203">2025</a> as investments have matured.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">The Company&#8217;s stockholders&#8217; equity represented <a data-tblloc="9x4" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736544894612">9.7%</a>&nbsp;of total assets as of <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381205963">December 31, 2025</a> with all of the Company&#8217;s six affiliate banks considered well-capitalized as defined by federal capital regulations. Total stockholders&#8217; equity was <a data-tblloc="10x1" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736544915536">$207.9</a>&nbsp;million as of <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381205963">December 31, 2025</a>, compared to <a data-tblloc="10x2" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736544921200">$174.7</a>&nbsp;million as of <a data-tblloc="6x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F2024831725381255054">December 31, 2024</a>. The&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="10x5" data-tblname="577185" data-tblv="9" id="led577185F20250101736544928836">increase</a> in stockholders&#8217; equity was primarily the result of a decrease in unrealized losses on the investment portfolio and retention of net income in excess of dividends.</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><b>Share Repurchase Program</b></p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">For the period October 1, 2025&nbsp;through December 31, 2025, under the repurchase program that was announced in August 2025, which allowed for the repurchase of 200,000 shares of common stock, the Company repurchased 34,947 shares of its common stock at an average price of $20.98&nbsp;per share and a total cost of $733&nbsp;thousand. There were 165,053 shares available to be repurchased under that repurchase program as of December 31, 2025.</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">The weighted average outstanding shares for the three months ended&nbsp;December 31, 2025 and 2024&nbsp;was 8,869,276 and 8,988,663, respectively. The weighted average outstanding shares for the&nbsp;year&nbsp;ended December 31, 2025 and 2024&nbsp;was 8,895,197&nbsp;and 8,991,286, respectively. The Company had no potentially dilutive securities outstanding during the periods presented.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><b>Cash Dividend Announcement</b></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">On November 12, 2025, the Company declared a quarterly cash dividend on common stock, payable on December 15, 2025 to stockholders of record as of December 1, 2025, equal to $0.20 per share.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><b>Forecasted Earnings</b></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">The Company is forecasting earnings for the year ending December 31,&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="20x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F20260141768424718482">2026</a> in the range of $2.70 to $2.80&nbsp;per share compared to $2.14 per share earned for the year ended <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F20260141768424728336">December 31, 2025</a>. The increase in forecasted earnings from&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="577153" data-tblv="9" id="led577153F20260141768424736362">2025</a> actual results is primarily due to an anticipated improvement in net interest margin as lower yielding investments and loans are expected to reprice at higher rates and cost of funds are expected to decrease&nbsp;due to lower market rates.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

</div>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><b>About Ames National Corporation</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">Ames National Corporation affiliate Iowa banks are First National Bank, Ames; Boone Bank &amp; Trust Co., Boone; State Bank &amp; Trust Co., Nevada; Reliance State Bank, Story City; United Bank &amp; Trust Co., Marshalltown; and Iowa State Savings Bank, Creston, Iowa.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left"><b>AVERAGE BALANCES AND INTEREST RATES</b>&nbsp;<i>(unaudited)</i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">The following two tables are used to calculate the Company&#8217;s non-GAAP net interest margin on a fully taxable equivalent (FTE) basis. The first table includes the Company&#8217;s average assets and the related income to determine the average yield on earning assets. The second table includes the average liabilities and related expense to determine the average rate paid on interest-bearing liabilities. The net interest margin is equal to interest income less interest expense divided by average earning assets.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" data-tblname="798265" data-tblv="9" style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;width:100%;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;">

			</td>
		</tr>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Non-GAAP Financial Measures</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">This report contains references to financial measures that are not defined in GAAP.&nbsp;Such non-GAAP financial measures include the Company&#8217;s presentation of net interest income and net interest margin on an FTE&nbsp;basis. Management believes these non-GAAP financial measures are widely used in the financial institutions industry and provide useful information to both management and investors to analyze and evaluate the Company&#8217;s financial performance. Limitations associated with non-GAAP financial measures include the risks that persons might disagree as to the appropriateness of items included in these measures and that different companies might calculate these measures differently. These non-GAAP disclosures should not be considered an alternative to the Company&#8217;s GAAP results. The following table reconciles the non-GAAP financial measures of net interest income and net interest margin on an FTE basis to GAAP&nbsp;<i>(dollars in thousands)</i>.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>
